evidence.quote: the e2e suite asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer

observations.why: Stating what the test suite asserts supplies the controlling facts of the matter — informational power as the speaker governs what is taken to be true.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion

observations.why: Framing the memory's entire purpose as carrying the prior assertion reinforces informational control — the speaker defines what the artifact is for.
